title: Dice and coin
description: Flip a coin, roll dice, ask the magic ball or make a strong password

actions.label: Roll a die
actions.command: od -An -N2 -tu2 /dev/urandom | awk '{split("⚀ ⚁ ⚂ ⚃ ⚄ ⚅",f," "); n=$1%6+1; print f[n] "  " n}'

actions.label: Magic ball
actions.command: od -An -N2 -tu2 /dev/urandom | awk '{split("It is certain|Without a doubt|Yes, definitely|Most likely|Outlook good|Signs point to yes|Ask again later|Cannot predict now|Concentrate and ask again|Better not tell you now|Do not count on it|My reply is no|Very doubtful|Outlook not so good",a,"|"); print "🎱 " a[$1%14+1]}'
